results.title: Shadow World (role playing game)
results.text: Shadow World is a high-fantasy campaign setting situated on the fictional planet of Kulthea. Originally produced for the Rolemaster role-playing game system, the game setting is owned by Iron Crown Enterprises (often referred to as I.C.E.). It is currently maintained by the primary author of the setting, Terry K. Amthor of Eidolon Studio (who also holds the trademark for Shadow World, and copyrights for non-gaming fiction related to the world).

results.title: Temoer Terry
results.text: Temoer Terry (born June 12, 1975 in McPherson, Kansas) is a former college wrestling champion. Wrestling out of the University of Nebraska, (1994–1998), he had a collegiate record of 100-24. Terry had a record of 79-3 at McPherson High School. Terry has also coached at the college level for American University. Also coached for George Mason University
